title: Rental Walkthrough Red Flag Scorecard — Gemini model variant
description: A developer-operated Gemini rerun of the canonical Rental Walkthrough Red Flag Scorecard brief, preserved as an auditable PathForge Labs model variant rather than a community fork.

comparison_basis.opening_prompt_exact: Can you make a saveable offline browser scorecard I can use during an apartment walkthrough to rate each room, note hazards and lease-risk clues, attach photo notes, and copy a clean inspection brief at the end?
acceptance_criteria: Support room-by-room scoring with hazards, lease-risk clues, severity, and evidence or photo-note fields.
Keep the overall rental assessment synchronized with the current room findings.
Provide useful local save or restore behavior without uploading private inspection data.
Provide a clean copyable or downloadable inspection brief suitable for a real rental decision.
Produce one complete self-contained HTML file that is immediately usable in a browser.
Operate offline with no external APIs, hosted generation, CDNs, remote fonts, scripts, stylesheets, or fragile dependencies.
Avoid unsafe HTML sinks, eval-like execution, inline event handlers, modal dialogs, and deprecated clipboard handling.
Avoid page-level horizontal overflow at 390 by 844 and at desktop width.
Keep essential controls visible, keyboard or touch reachable, and truthful about their current state.
Preserve exact prompt, response, source, and artifact-version evidence for the run.
comparison_basis.adaptive_repair_policy: Preserve and score the first real artifact. Continue only when verification proves a concrete defect or a source-capture failure; use the same source session and model; name the observed defect in ordinary language; preserve every real artifact version; stop as soon as the artifact passes; prefer no more than three total prompts and go beyond three only for a documented concrete lane reason such as a verification-proven regression, truncation, or mechanical capture failure.
comparison_basis.independence_note: Gemini received the invariant brief in a fresh session and was not shown the historical implementation, screenshots, source code, or another provider's output.

agent_notes: Model settings: Gemini web; Pro mode.
PathForge Labs provenance: developer-operated comparison run; not a user, community fork, vote, bookmark, or engagement event.

Prompt count: 4. Three verification-driven repairs removed unsafe rendering and modals, replaced the missed confirm() call, and restored the overall rating and risk summary lost during the safety repair.
All four real artifact versions are preserved under public/artifacts. The fourth artifact is the default selectable version for this model run.

Final verification passed all ten fixed contract checks, static safety, JavaScript parsing, live room and risk scoring, synchronized overall summary, brief generation, local save and restore, in-page clear confirmation, desktop rendering, and measured 390x844 no-overflow checks.

artifact_version_notes.disposition: Preserved first response; not default because it used inline handlers, innerHTML, alert(), and confirm().
Preserved first repair; not default because confirm() remained in the clear action.
Preserved third response; safe but not default because its brief no longer provided the required overall rating and global risk summary.
Final verified Gemini artifact and default version; all ten contract checks passed.

verification_notes: The final artifact's single inline script parsed successfully.

Static scan found no external URL, remote dependency, fetch, XHR, unsafe HTML sink, eval-like execution, inline handler, document.write, modal API, deprecated clipboard handling, or negative letter spacing.
Direct verification saved two rated rooms with separate risk and photo evidence, calculated a 3.0 average with two risks, and synchronized to 4.0 with Mold/Mildew after one room was removed.
The generated 275-character inspection brief preserved the same 4.0 overall rating and Mold/Mildew risk; localStorage restored the remaining room, address, and visible summary after reload.
In-page Confirm Delete and Cancel controls worked. Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors.

notes: Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors.
The live workflow saved a 2/5 Kitchen with water-damage and photo evidence to localStorage and generated an inspection brief containing a 2.0/5.0 average plus global risk factors.
The first artifact failed the shared safety check with three dynamic innerHTML sinks, six inline event-handler attributes, and three blocking alert/confirm calls.
Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors, and the static hard-gate scan passed.

Direct workflow verified multi-room severity, risks and photo evidence, a synchronized live overall assessment, matching overall values in the brief, local save and reload restore, and in-page clear confirmation.
All four project-specific checks and all six shared production checks passed.

steps.title: Build the invariant rental walkthrough brief
steps.prompt_exact: Can you make a saveable offline browser scorecard I can use during an apartment walkthrough to rate each room, note hazards and lease-risk clues, attach photo notes, and copy a clean inspection brief at the end?
steps.response_summary: Gemini produced the first complete offline apartment walkthrough scorecard.
steps.notes: Preserved first artifact. Verification found inline handlers, innerHTML, alert(), and confirm().

steps.title: Repair unsafe handlers, rendering, and modal validation
steps.prompt_exact: I tested the saved scorecard and my public viewer rejects it because it uses inline event attributes, renders room data with innerHTML, and opens alert/confirm dialogs. Replace the handlers with addEventListener, render every room and message with createElement/textContent, and use inline validation plus an in-page clear confirmation while keeping local saving, room/hazard notes, brief generation, copy, and the complete offline HTML.
steps.response_summary: Gemini rewired events and safe rendering but retained confirm() in the clear action.
steps.continuation_reason: Verification-proven defects: unsafe inline handlers, dynamic innerHTML, and blocking alert/confirm dialogs.

steps.title: Replace the remaining blocking clear confirmation
steps.prompt_exact: The revised file still calls confirm('Erase all data?'), so the blocking modal defect remains. Replace that clear action with a visible in-page two-step confirmation or cancel control, keep every other repaired behavior unchanged, and return the complete self-contained HTML again.
steps.response_summary: Gemini replaced confirm() with in-page Confirm Delete and Cancel controls.
steps.continuation_reason: Verification-proven defect: the first repair still called confirm('Erase all data?').
steps.notes: Current safe artifact. Contract verification found the overall assessment regression, so another same-session repair is required before release.

steps.title: Restore the synchronized overall rental assessment
steps.prompt_exact: The current safe revision accidentally dropped the overall assessment that the first version had. Restore a live overall condition rating and risk summary that updates whenever rooms are added or removed, and include the same overall rating and risk in the copied inspection brief. Keep the room severity, hazards and lease-risk clues, photo notes, local save and restore, safe createElement/textContent rendering, addEventListener wiring, and the in-page Confirm Delete and Cancel controls. Keep it as one offline HTML file with no horizontal overflow at 390px, and return the complete updated HTML.
